svg.title: Catching Days
svg.desc: A dusk pond. Koi, goldfish, a betta and an axolotl swim past while a dragonfly, firefly, bee and butterfly drift over the reeds. Nine toads sit along the shore.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

g.text: PLAN A LITTLE · FOCUS FOR A WHILE · WATCH SOMETHING GROW
